title: Drupal Core: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed, but the vulnerability is more than a year old and we see no ransomware use, public attack tools, internet-facing product, critical severity or high prediction score. Check whether it applies to you.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 27, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
